freeze_scope: Local versioned protocol; no claim of external public preregistration
name_convention_gate: Explicitly abstain without a source name convention; same gate in matched per-record comparator

operating_point.interpretation: Validation-selected engineering target; not a human-verified semantic guarantee

order_policy: Fixed main-order hash; four 2000-event regimes x five seeds; fresh empty memory for every model/policy/order

annotation.mode: Two fresh input-only model-assisted review passes; configured gpt-6.1-sol, medium reasoning
annotation.reference_policy: Primary source/construction agreement; separate model-assisted-consensus and conservative unresolved-case sensitivity

analysis.uncertainty: 2000 paired cluster bootstrap resamples within cohort; D1/D4 address-layout clusters, D2 county clusters, D3 base-input clusters; 95% descriptive intervals, no independence claim for model passes or order seeds
analysis.report_failure_policy: All attempted inputs and generation/service failures retained; no outcome-driven subset changes
analysis.scope: Controlled/reference benchmark with model-assisted audit; no human-verified real-world accuracy claim

future_changes: Predictive changes require a recorded amendment and new study version, never silent tuning on this final test

publication.annotation_description: Tool-neutral names and prompt/output artifacts; human annotation count remains zero
publication.scope: Publication metadata and offline analysis adapters differ; predictions, scores, cohorts and 19 frozen predictive sources are preserved
